title: U2UData+: A Scalable Swarm UAVs Autonomous Flight Dataset for Embodied Long-horizon Tasks

layout.note: Top row: a dashed card, the wide hero mosaic with its ribbon in the middle, a dashed card. Bottom row: three dashed cards. Every card has a dark slate title tab on its top edge, a pale green fill, one or two pictures and a bold sentence under them. No arrows join the cards.

lesson: For a dataset-plus-platform paper, put a branded hero mosaic of real samples in the middle and surround it with capability cards, each with a title tab, one picture and a single sentence that says what scales.
